Xbro10 fork, NPC autonomy. A guard on their post during their shift still takes mealtimes, from their pack and without leaving the post (the meal goal never walks). Weight 0.5 beats holding the post (0.45); the plain meal (0.35) doesn't.
Xbro10 fork, NPC autonomy (option NPC_AUTONOMY). Social 50+: walk over to a friendly person within 15 tiles and chat (at most every 30 minutes). score_argument is the weight (0-1).

Xbro10 fork, NPC autonomy (option NPC_AUTONOMY), step 3.4. Water 50+ (Very thirsty): drink from the pack, or walk up to 20 tiles to water the NPC can see, drink, and fill an empty bottle at clean water. 3 failed targets in a row and they give up for an hour. Uses the game's own drink-water planner, which otherwise waits for Parched and looks 6 tiles. score_argument is the weight (0-1); following a far-off player scores 0.3-0.6.

Xbro10 fork, NPC autonomy (option NPC_AUTONOMY), step 3.4b. Food 50+ (Very hungry): eat from the pack, or walk up to 20 tiles to food the NPC can see (in containers, cupboards and fridges too; never anything owned) and eat it there. 3 failed targets in a row and they give up for an hour. Uses the game's own eat-food planner, which otherwise waits until starving and looks 6 tiles. Same weight as water; the follow and guard limits and the 'leave food and water to me' rule apply.

Xbro10 fork, NPC autonomy (option NPC_AUTONOMY), step 3.4c. Warmth 50+ (between the game's Cold and Very cold; it waits for Very cold): warmer clothes from the pack, else stand by a hearth fire they can see, else with a firestarter take firewood (carried or picked up nearby, never owned) to a fireplace, wood stove or fire pit and light it, else the game's own planner (shelter, clothes nearby). Only ever lights hearths. Beside a fire they stay until Warmth is under 25. Followers stay near the player, guards near their post, others go up to 20 tiles; 3 failed tries and they give up for an hour. Scores 0.45, or the game's own temperature urgency when higher: the game's warming branch (npc_homeostasis) steps aside while this one wants warmth.
